visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a hospital-style room where a middle-aged woman in a light blue patterned patient gown sits in a hospital bed with a wooden tray across her lap. A light green privacy curtain is partially visible on the left side of the frame. (2) A young man with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a white t-shirt, enters quickly from the right. He begins scrubbing the wooden tray table with extreme intensity and rapid hand movements while the woman watches him with a look of amusement. (3) The man continues his vigorous cleaning, leaning close to the table as his body sways with the effort. Cartoon fire graphics are edited onto the edges of the frame to visualize his high energy, while the woman remains seated, resting her hands on the bed. (4) He stops cleaning and efficiently unlatches the tray table, folding it away with a swift motion. He then moves to the foot of the bed to manipulate the frame and bedding, maintaining a pace of high physical activity throughout the scene. (5) The man approaches the woman's legs and a circular inset appears, magnifying his hand as he rhythmicly moves her leg. He concludes the sequence by looking at the camera with a broad smile and a laugh while walking toward the lens.
